scripts.script:
-- List of usernames to kick (case-sensitive)
local usernamesToKick = {
    "BadUser123",
    "TrollPlayer456",
    "Spammer789"
}

-- Function to kick players in the list
game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    for _, username in ipairs(usernamesToKick) do
        if player.Name == username then
            player:Kick("You are not allowed in this game.")
            warn("Kicked player: " .. player.Name)
        end
    end
end)
